name: Brown Bear Internet
summary: Budget national ISP (from $9.95; dialup + ADSL + ISDN + hosting, by 2005); defunct c. 2009-10.

events.details: Dialup + ADSL + ISDN + hosting; earliest Wayback capture 15 Jun 2005 (brownbear.net.au).
Retail homepage served content through 13 Oct 2009 (last live capture); from Feb 2011 brownbear.net.au returned only 301 redirects. Defunct by ~2010.
